name: Grants.gov
summary: US federal grant opportunities from Grants.gov: keyword and filter search over forecasted, posted, closed and archived opportunities, and the full detail of one opportunity.
notes: search2 and fetchOpportunity are keyless; other Grants.gov REST APIs need a key issued through the Help Desk and are not listed here.
Both calls are reads over POST with a JSON body, and wrap the answer as {errorcode, msg, token, data}; errorcode 0 means success.
Multi-value filters are one string joined with '|' (e.g. oppStatuses 'forecasted|posted').

endpoints.name: Search grant opportunities
endpoints.summary: Opportunities matching a keyword and filters, with id, number, title, agency, open and close dates, status and assistance listing numbers, plus facet counts.

oppStatuses.description: Statuses joined with '|': forecasted, posted, closed, archived.

eligibilities.description: Eligibility code(s), e.g. 01 for county governments.

fundingCategories.description: Funding category code(s), e.g. HL (health), AR (arts).

notes: The response's facet lists (oppStatusOptions, eligibilities, fundingCategories, fundingInstruments, agencies) give the codes valid for the filters, with counts.

endpoints.name: Get a grant opportunity
endpoints.summary: Full detail of one opportunity: synopsis, agency contact, award ceiling and floor, dates, eligibility and category.

opportunityId.description: Opportunity id (the 'id' from a search hit, not the opportunity number).
